description: This file contains unit tests for the 'ChunkProcessor' class, specifically testing extraction of tool call content and usage calculation from streaming chat completion chunks in the Litellm project.

classes.name: ChunkProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing streaming chunk data, extracting tool call contents, and calculating token usage.

methods.name: test_get_combined_tool_content()
methods.description: Tests that the ChunkProcessor correctly extracts and combines tool call content from chunks.

methods.name: test_cache_read_input_tokens_retained()
methods.description: Verifies that token caching information in chunks is correctly utilized during usage calculation.

methods.name: test_stream_chunk_builder_litellm_usage_chunks()
methods.description: Ensures that token usage is reconstructed accurately from chunks' usage data without upstream API calls.

methods.name: test_stream_chunk_builder_anthropic_web_search()
methods.description: Checks that special usage data such as web search request counts are handled correctly in usage calculations.
